name: Start Here
description: New to Interactive Guides? Begin with this orientation handbook to get a bird's-eye view of the entire frontend landscape.

name: Web Basics
description: Understand how the internet works and master the foundational technologies of the web — HTML, CSS, and the DOM.

name: JavaScript
description: Master JavaScript from core fundamentals to objects, memory management, and asynchronous programming.

name: React
description: Build modern user interfaces with hooks, forms, API integration, routing, performance optimization, and accessibility.

name: UI / Design
description: Learn design system fundamentals, component design with tokens and variants, and master Material UI.

name: Tooling
description: Set up your dev environment, master Git and CI/CD workflows, and learn how to deploy applications to production.

name: Quality
description: Write code that lasts — frontend architecture and planning, plus comprehensive testing strategies from unit to E2E.

name: Security
description: Protect your applications — master frontend authentication, JWT, OAuth, secure token storage, and route protection.

name: Data
description: Work with data effectively — learn SQL from SELECT queries to joins, aggregations, and database design fundamentals.
